```{r}
# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(knitr)
library(broom)
library(lmerTest)
library(plotrix)
library(gtools)
library(emmeans)
library(effectsize)
library(mediation)
library(afex)
library(effsize)
library(bwrappers)
library(apa)
afex_options(emmeans_model = "multivariate")
```

```{r}
# Import data
col_names <- names(read_csv(here("data", "disagree_supp2_raw_data.csv")))
raw_data <- read_csv(here("data", "disagree_supp2_raw_data.csv"), 
                     col_names = col_names, skip = 3)
```


```{r}
# Filter out incomplete (or preview) responses, and rename some variable
disagree_data <- raw_data %>%
  filter(Finished == 1, Status == 0, !is.na(pol_orient)) %>%
  mutate(target_condition = factor(target_condition,
                                   levels = c("self", "other")),
         goal_condition = factor(goal_condition,
                                 levels = c("no_goal", "goal")),
         choice_advice = ifelse(is.na(choice), advice, choice),
         enjoy_agree = ifelse(is.na(enjoy_agree_s), enjoy_agree_o, enjoy_agree_s),
         awk_agree = ifelse(is.na(awk_agree_s), awk_agree_o, awk_agree_s),
         learn_agree = ifelse(is.na(learn_agree_s), learn_agree_o, learn_agree_s),
         hostile_agree = ifelse(is.na(hostile_agree_s), hostile_agree_o, hostile_agree_s),
         like_agree = ifelse(is.na(like_agree_s), like_agree_o, like_agree_s),
         p_like_agree = ifelse(is.na(p_like_agree_s), p_like_agree_o, p_like_agree_s),
         connect_agree = ifelse(is.na(connect_agree_s), connect_agree_o, connect_agree_s),
         enjoy_disagree = ifelse(is.na(enjoy_disagree_s), enjoy_disagree_o, enjoy_disagree_s),
         awk_disagree = ifelse(is.na(awk_disagree_s), awk_disagree_o, awk_disagree_s),
         learn_disagree = ifelse(is.na(learn_disagree_s), learn_disagree_o, learn_disagree_s),
          hostile_disagree = ifelse(is.na(hostile_disagree_s), hostile_disagree_o, hostile_disagree_s),
          like_disagree = ifelse(is.na(like_disagree_s), like_disagree_o, like_disagree_s),
          p_like_disagree = ifelse(is.na(p_like_disagree_s), p_like_disagree_o, p_like_disagree_s),
          connect_disagree = ifelse(is.na(connect_disagree_s), connect_disagree_o, connect_disagree_s),
         pol_orient_group = fct_recode(factor(pol_orient),
                                      "liberal" = "-3",
                                      "liberal" = "-2",
                                      "liberal" = "-1",
                                      "independent" = "0",
                                      "conservative" = "1",
                                      "conservative" = "2",
                                      "conservative" = "3"))
```

```{r}
# Create long-form dataset with agree and disagree prediction measures as separate rows
disagree_data_agree <- disagree_data %>%
  dplyr::select(-enjoy_disagree:-connect_disagree) %>%
  rename(enjoy = enjoy_agree,
         awk = awk_agree,
         learn = learn_agree,
         hostile = hostile_agree,
         like = like_agree,
         p_like = p_like_agree,
         connect = connect_agree) %>%
  mutate(agree_condition = "agree")

disagree_data_disagree <- disagree_data %>%
  dplyr::select(-enjoy_agree:-connect_agree) %>%
  rename(enjoy = enjoy_disagree,
         awk = awk_disagree,
         learn = learn_disagree,
         hostile = hostile_disagree,
         like = like_disagree,
         p_like = p_like_disagree,
         connect = connect_disagree) %>%
  mutate(agree_condition = "disagree")

disagree_data_long <- bind_rows(disagree_data_agree, disagree_data_disagree) %>%
  mutate(agree_condition = factor(agree_condition),
         composite = (enjoy + (10 - awk) + learn + (10 - hostile)) / 4)
```

```{r}
# Plotting function for prediction DVs
plot <- function(data, dv) {
  data %>%
    group_by(target_condition, agree_condition) %>%
    summarize(mean = mean(!!enquo(dv)),
              lower = mean(!!enquo(dv)) - std.error(!!enquo(dv)),
              upper = mean(!!enquo(dv)) + std.error(!!enquo(dv))) %>%
    ggplot(mapping = aes(x = target_condition, y = mean, fill = agree_condition)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(1), color = "black") +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), width = .4, position = position_dodge(1)) +
    theme_classic()
}
```

\newpage

# Proportion Choosing Agree

## Total Counts/Proportions

*0 is disagree selected, 1 is agree selected*

```{r}
disagree_data %>%
  group_by(choice_advice) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(count = n(),
                   proportion = count/nrow(disagree_data)*100) %>%
  kable()
```

## Test greater than 50%

```{r}
wrap.chi(factor(disagree_data$choice_advice))
```

## Logistic Regression

```{r}
log_model <- glm(choice_advice ~ target_condition * goal_condition, data = disagree_data,
                 family = "binomial")
summary(log_model)
```

## Proportions by Condition

```{r}
disagree_data %>%
  group_by(goal_condition, target_condition) %>%
  summarize(proportion = mean(choice_advice),
            n = n(),
            se = sqrt(proportion * (1 - proportion) / n)) %>%
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = target_condition, y = proportion, fill = goal_condition)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(1)) +
  geom_errorbar(mapping = aes(ymin = proportion - se, ymax = proportion + se),
                width = 0.4, position = position_dodge(1)) +
  labs(title = "Proportion Choosing Agreement")
```

*Error bars are 1 standard error.*

# Prediction DVs

## Alpha for Composite

```{r}
alpha_composite <- psych::alpha(data.frame(disagree_data_long$enjoy, (10 - disagree_data_long$awk),
                                                disagree_data_long$learn, (10 - disagree_data_long$hostile))) %>%
  summary() %>%
  kable()
```

*Note that this is the alpha with agree and disagree conditions combined.*

## Composite

```{r}
plot(disagree_data_long, composite)
```

```{r}
composite_anova <- aov_car(composite ~ target_condition * agree_condition + Error(ResponseId/agree_condition),
                            within = ("agree_condition"), data = disagree_data_long, type = "III",
                            anova_table = list(es = "pes"), include_aov = TRUE)
anova_apa(composite_anova, print = FALSE) %>%
  kable()
```


```{r}
pairs(emmeans(composite_anova, "target_condition")) %>%
  kable()
```

anova_apa(like_anova, print = FALSE) %>%

# Looking at Expectations by Choice/Advice

*1 is the people who chose/advised agreement, and 0 the people who chose/advised disagreement.*

## Composite

```{r}
disagree_data_long %>%
    group_by(choice_advice, agree_condition) %>%
    summarize(mean = mean(composite),
              lower = mean(composite) - std.error(composite),
              upper = mean(composite) + std.error(composite)) %>%
    ggplot(mapping = aes(x = factor(choice_advice), y = mean, fill = agree_condition)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(1), color = "black") +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), width = .4, position = position_dodge(1)) +
    theme_classic()
```

```{r}
composite2_anova <- aov_car(composite ~ choice_advice * agree_condition + Error(ResponseId/agree_condition),
                            within = ("agree_condition"), data = disagree_data_long, type = "III",
                            anova_table = list(es = "pes"), include_aov = TRUE)
anova_apa(composite2_anova, print = FALSE) %>%
  kable()
```

```{r}
pairs(emmeans(composite2_anova, "agree_condition", by = "choice_advice"))
```

```{r}
# Means and SEs for excel graph
disagree_data_long %>%
    group_by(choice_advice, agree_condition) %>%
    summarize(mean = round(mean(composite),2),
              se = round(std.error(composite),2))
```
